five_minutes: RBI’s ₹2 trn VRRR auction on Sept 28 adds liquidity, anchoring overnight rates and supporting short‑term G‑sec yields.
India’s H2 bond plan of ₹7.86 lakh cr could push 10‑yr yields up despite trimmed FY borrowing.
Q1 FY27 FDI equity inflows up 6% to $19.8 bn while US inflows plunge, shaping INR demand.
RBI money‑supply data shows modest growth, keeping inflation outlook unchanged.
U.S. Henry Hub gas price down 6% YoY, easing power‑generation costs and tempering Indian coal demand.

buckets.label: What you need to know today

items.headline: U.S. Henry Hub natural‑gas price down 6% YoY this summer, easing power‑generation input costs
items.what_happened: The Henry Hub spot price averaged $2.93 per MMBtu from June‑August, 6% lower than the same period last year.
items.why_it_matters: Lower gas prices reduce cost pressures on gas‑fired power plants, which can temper demand for imported coal and influence Indian power‑sector margins.

items.headline: India plans ₹7.86 lakh cr bond sales in H2, trimming overall FY borrowing and pressuring 10‑yr yields
items.what_happened: The government announced a target of ₹7.86 trillion in bond issuances between October 2026 and March 2027, while capping total FY borrowing at ₹16 trn.
items.why_it_matters: The sizable H2 supply could lift 10‑year G‑sec yields, while the reduced overall borrowing limit may temper upward pressure, impacting fixed‑income portfolios.
items.action: Monitor the 10‑yr G‑sec yield curve for any upward move in the coming weeks.

items.headline: Q1 FY27 FDI equity inflows rise 6% to $19.8 bn; US inflows fall 76%, reshaping foreign capital flows
items.what_happened: India recorded $19.81 bn of equity FDI in April‑June FY27, a 6% rise YoY, while US‑originated equity FDI dropped 76% to $1.34 bn.
items.why_it_matters: Higher overall FDI supports rupee demand, whereas the US outflow may reduce dollar‑linked inflows, influencing the USD/INR balance and equity market sentiment.
items.action: Watch upcoming FII/FPI flow data for any reversal in US‑originated capital trends.

items.headline: RBI releases money‑supply data for the fortnight ended 15 Sept, showing modest growth
items.what_happened: The Reserve Bank published figures on money supply (M3) for the two‑week period ending 15 September 2026.
items.why_it_matters: Money‑supply trends feed into inflation expectations and guide RBI’s policy stance, influencing bond yields and credit conditions.

items.headline: FEMA amendment tightens export‑import reporting, likely raising compliance costs and marginally pressuring INR volatility
items.what_happened: The RBI issued amended Foreign Exchange Management (Export and Import of Goods and Services) Regulations, 2026.
items.why_it_matters: Stricter reporting can dampen trade‑related FX flows, modestly increasing demand for RBI intervention and adding a compliance burden for exporters and importers.

items.headline: RBI September bulletin flags credit‑deposit divergence and slowing corporate investment, hinting at tighter credit conditions
items.what_happened: The September 2026 RBI bulletin featured articles on the state of the economy, credit‑deposit divergence, and private corporate investment trends.
items.why_it_matters: Widening credit‑deposit gaps and muted corporate capex signal potential pressure on bank loan growth and profitability, which can affect equity valuations in the banking sector.

items.headline: RBI to conduct a ₹2 trn overnight VRRR auction on 28 Sept, providing fresh liquidity
items.what_happened: The RBI announced a Variable Rate Reverse Repo auction of ₹2,00,000 cr for one day on 28 September 2026.
items.why_it_matters: The operation injects liquidity into the money market, helping to anchor the policy‑rate corridor and supporting short‑term funding for banks and corporates.

items.headline: RBI's 91‑day, 182‑day and 364‑day T‑Bill auction adds ₹24 bn of short‑term debt, keeping near‑term yields anchored
items.what_happened: Reserve Bank of India announced the auction of ₹9,000 cr 91‑day, ₹8,000 cr 182‑day and ₹7,000 cr 364‑day Treasury Bills for September 30‑October 1, 2026.
items.why_it_matters: The new short‑term supply supports money‑market liquidity, influences overnight repo rates and sets the floor for short‑duration G‑sec yields, affecting banks' funding costs.

items.headline: State‑government bond auction of ₹22,200 cr adds new supply, likely nudging state‑bond yields higher
items.what_happened: State governments offered to sell securities worth ₹22,200 cr across various tenors, including a re‑issue of a 7.83% Assam bond.
items.why_it_matters: Increased state‑bond issuance can lift yields on SG‑bonds, tightening credit spreads for banks with SG‑bond exposure and affecting the broader debt market.

items.headline: RBI raises Ways‑and‑Means Advances limit to ₹50 trn for Oct‑Mar, signalling liquidity back‑stop capacity
items.what_happened: The RBI, in consultation with the Government, increased the WMA ceiling to ₹50,000 cr for the October 2026–March 2027 period.
items.why_it_matters: A higher WMA limit gives the RBI room to inject liquidity during stress, helping to cap short‑term rate spikes and supporting INR funding conditions for banks.

items.headline: RBI drafts directions on novation of OTC derivative contracts to centralise counterparty risk
items.what_happened: The RBI issued draft directions for the novation of OTC derivative contracts, outlining a framework for transferring contracts to a central clearing entity.
items.why_it_matters: The move will reshape the OTC derivatives market, affecting banks' risk management, margin requirements and potentially improving market transparency.

items.headline: SEBI settlement with Adani group firms lifts regulatory cloud, likely stabilising Adani equities
items.what_happened: SEBI issued a settlement order in the matter of Adani Group Companies, resolving outstanding compliance issues.
items.why_it_matters: Removal of regulatory uncertainty can curb short‑term volatility in Adani‑related stocks and reduce sector‑wide risk for investors holding exposure.

items.headline: RBI issues amendment directions on classification, valuation and operation of investment portfolios for financial institutions
items.what_happened: The RBI released amended directions governing how all‑India financial institutions classify, value and operate their investment portfolios.
items.why_it_matters: Changes will affect banks' asset‑valuation practices and capital adequacy calculations, influencing balance‑sheet strength and potentially credit supply.

items.headline: Cabinet to ease bilateral‑investment‑treaty litigation timeline, potentially boosting foreign investment
items.what_happened: The government proposes a model to shorten the mandatory five‑year domestic litigation period before pursuing international arbitration under existing BITs.
items.why_it_matters: A faster dispute‑resolution mechanism makes India more attractive to foreign investors, which could lift FDI inflows and affect equity valuations.
